from collections import defaultdict
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='as_moore@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
user_email='as_moore@gmail.com'

# Fetch liked playlists (paginated)
liked_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_playlists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('liked_playlists page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    liked_playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

# Unique song ids from liked playlists
song_ids=set()
for p in liked_playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]):
        song_ids.add(sid)
song_ids_list=sorted(song_ids)
print('unique song_ids', len(song_ids_list))

# Fetch user's reviews for each song (paginated)
song_reviews = {}  # sid -> list of reviews
for sid in song_ids_list:
    reviews=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid, user_email=user_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not resp:
            break
        reviews.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    song_reviews[sid]=reviews
    ratings=[r['rating'] for r in reviews]
    print('song', sid, 'reviews', len(reviews), 'ratings', ratings)

updates=[] # review_id to update
creates=[] # song_id to create
for sid,reviews in song_reviews.items():
    if not reviews:
        creates.append(sid)
        continue
    for r in reviews:
        if r.get('rating') is not None and r['rating'] < 5:
            updates.append((r['song_review_id'], r['rating'], sid))

print('planned updates', len(updates))
print('planned creates', len(creates))
print('updates detail', updates)
print('creates detail', creates)

# Apply updates
update_results=[]
for review_id, current_rating, sid in updates:
    res = apis.spotify.update_song_review(review_id=review_id, access_token=access_token, rating=5)
    update_results.append((review_id,current_rating,res))
    print('updated review', review_id, 'song', sid, 'from', current_rating, 'to 5 ->', res)

# Apply creates
create_results=[]
for sid in creates:
    res = apis.spotify.review_song(song_id=sid, rating=5, access_token=access_token, title='', text='')
    create_results.append((sid,res))
    print('created review song', sid, '->', res)

print('done updates', len(update_results), 'creates', len(create_results))
